# get_indexed_flux_expressions

`#!python get_indexed_flux_expressions()`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Return per-reaction flux expressions as an `IndexedList`.

Each flux is the product of the reaction's rate coefficient and all
reactant densities::

    flux[i] = k[$IDX$] * y[r1] * y[r2] * …

The `$IDX$` placeholder is left literal here and replaced with the
concrete reaction index when the expressions are rendered to a string
by `get_flux_expressions_str` or
`TemplateParser`.

**Returns**

_IndexedList_
: One entry per reaction.  Each entry is an
    `IndexedValue` of `([reaction_index], flux_str)`.
